evidence: Initializes the caller output, resolves the nested context through the global entry at 0x700227f000+0x620, obtains selector 0x1d via nested_attribute_provider_get_float, converts it to a signed integer, stores the first value, then resolves a second provider and adds its selector-0x1d integer value. No indexed caller is available (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:24890-24927).

Rounds/scales the input vector float, stores its signed 16-bit conversion at the nested record pointer+0x14, and for positive input prepares the segment interpolation call and writes three float outputs at owner offsets +0x48,+0x4c,+0x50. It calls sampled_flight_segment_interpolate; an indexed caller is evaluate_catch_loco_working_ring_position, while other callers show the helper is shared (decompiled/main/main_0008.c:34096-34142; decompiled/main/main_0009.c:37927-37931).

Reads a selected 32-bit record value from a global table, then writes a boolean to the caller output. The value passes when it equals 0x1e, is in 0x20-0x22, or is in 0x81-0x82, provided context selector 0x13 is not status 6; unsupported values return false (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:35243-35288; range predicate at decompiled/main/main_0170.c:53656-53665). No indexed caller is available.

Returns 2 for a null input or when neither nested-provider value is positive; returns 1 when selector 0x2b is positive, otherwise returns 0 when selector 0x32 is positive. It obtains missing provider state through f_700183f6e4 and uses nested_attribute_provider_get_float. Its indexed caller stores the classification result (decompiled/main/main_0112.c:35414-35460; caller decompiled/main/main_0112.c:23762-23766).

When the input flag bit is clear, returns the float at input+0x1c. When set, loads a global mapping value (or uses 1.0 when absent), passes it through the linear_remap_clamped helper with fixed parameters, and returns the computed float after a low-bit selection. The numeric domain is unclear, so the label describes only the observed mapping path (decompiled/main/main_0029.c:18008-18050; indexed callers decompiled/main/main_0094.c:15094-15098 and decompiled/main/main_0149.c:14092-14096).
